songs.giong_ghi_chu: SHEET va BAN THU LECH NHAU DUNG 4 NUA CUNG (mot quang 3 truong). Sheet: Dm11 Gm9 A11 Em7b5 FM7 BbM7, ket DM9 — 114 ky hieu, khong cho nao mo ho. Chordify doc audio ra: F7 Bbm Ebm F. Anh xa Bbm->Dm, Ebm->Gm, F->A deu +4. KHONG phai Chordify doan sai kieu ngau nhien — lech co he thong. Bang chung nghieng ve phia SHEET la ban choi duoc: dich xuong 4 nua cung thi not thap nhat tay trai thanh midi 22 (Bb0, phim thu hai tu duoi cua dan 88 phim) — khong ai dem bolero o day. Nen kha nang cao AUDIO tren YouTube da bi ha cao do, hoac sheet la ban soan lai o giong khac. CHUA XAC DINH DUOC ben nao da doi. Moi phep do hien tai chay tren SHEET nen dung giong sheet.

moc.ghi: Loi hat vao tu not A4 phach 5.0 (not dau trong ba not den cuoi o). Ba not truoc la moc don, van la cau dao.
Cau hat het o cuoi not TRANG (A3, phach 4.0, dai 2 phach). Tu phach 6.0 tay phai chuyen sang tiet tau dem bolero xen ke.
Loi hat vao tu not tay phai dau tien cua o (G#5, phach 1.0). O 41 van la dan tron ven.
Nam not dau (phach 0-4) la dan MO PHONG giai dieu loi hat. Tu not thu 6 (G4, phach 4.0) moi la cau nhac rieng.
Hat toi het NOT TRANG D4 phach 4.0 — not nam duoi chu Dm. Tu phach 6.0 la fill. Cung dang voi o 6.
Hat toi het NOT TRANG D5 phach 0.0 (duoi Dm). Tu do la cau run, keo dai QUA VACH NHIP sang o 21. Bo do bat chuoi tu phach 2.0.
Cau run tu o 20 ket o dau lang phach 0.5-2.0. Loi hat (diep khuc) vao tu not den D5 phach 2.0.
Hat toi het NOT TRANG D5 phach 0.0. O nay dai 12 phach chu khong phai 8. Bo do bat chuoi moc don tu phach 2.5.
Cau run ket o dau lang phach 8.5-10.0, roi hat lai NGAY TRONG O nay tu not den D5 phach 10.0 — nen o 50 ngay not dau da la hat.
Chi hat o NOT DAU O (E5@0.0, dai 2 phach). Sau do tay trai dan tiet tau bolero.
Sau dau lang tay phai 3.5-5.0. Cau fill nam o TAY TRAI phach 6->8, di len E-F-G-A#, de tao cam giac don ve phan ke tiep.
Chi hat o not dau o (E5@0.0, dai 1 phach). O nay nhieu dau lang tay phai.
Cau fill tay trai phach 6->8, di len E-F-G-A# — TRUNG KHIT voi o 28.

Not dau o la loi hat. Sau do tay phai la cau dan LAP LAI giai dieu hat cua o 35, dich xuong mot quang tam (khop 50% theo lop cao do, 0% theo cao do tuyet doi). Tay trai co mot cau chay ngan. Cuoi o la cau run noi vao giang tau.

songs.moc_ghi_chu: O 65-70 nguoi dung chot LA HAT. Ban dau viet 'cau cuoi diep khuc'; 8/9/2026 sua: 'cau cuoi PHIEN KHUC, luc nay go nham'. verse_4 giu 57-70, KHONG tach. So do van khong khop 67-70 voi hai diep (cao nhat 17%) — dung, vi do la phien keo dai chu khong phai diep. O 30-35 (va 43-48, 58-63) HAT HET O — nguoi dung: 'toan la hat', may hoi thua. Diep 22-27 va 51-55 hat; cat dem/fill chi o 28 va 56 (da co moc).

_doc_giong: Truong/thu KHONG co trong file MusicXML (khong file nao ghi <mode>). giong_nguon = md-linh-nhi (chep tu bang trong knowledge/teachers/linh-nhi-piano.md, nguoi dung da xac nhan) hoac nguoi-dung-xac-nhan (nguoi dung doi chieu voi Chordify) hoac suy-tu-ket-doan (suy tu hop am ket cua tung doan + hop am hay dung; CHUA duoc nguoi dung xac nhan). KHONG suy bang dau hoa cua not: cac ban nay ky am tu dong tu MIDI, cach viet thang/giang chay theo bo dau hoa chu khong theo chuc nang — thu nghiem tren 7 bai da biet thi sai 5. Mot so DOAN co truong "giong" rieng de bao doan ay chuyen giong — khi do phai lay giong cua doan, khong lay giong cua bai.
